title: 'Utter shock and devastated': Fiona fans mourn beloved Cincinnati Zoo hippo
summary: Flowers and tributes piled up at Cincinnati Zoo on Saturday (November 21) as visitors mourned Fiona, a beloved Nile hippo who died earlier this week.
